scope: Static file/log inspection only; no Git command, build, test, interpreter import, source/config/docs edit or binary change.

cause.condition: Unconditional target BeforeTargets=PrepareForBuild; no local .git check
cause.gitversion_props: No PCbuild/gitversion.props in this pinned source; metadata target is inline in pythoncore.vcxproj.
cause.git_executable_property: GIT defaults to git; _GIT adds quotes for paths containing spaces
cause.exec_context: Exec has no -C or explicit WorkingDirectory. The project/source directories are below the authoritative engine Git worktree; no CPython .git exists. Ancestor engine metadata was written to IntDir git*.txt.
cause.output_handling: ContinueOnError=true; ReadAllText(...).Trim() sets GitBranch/GitVersion/GitTag from each existing generated file.
cause.definitions: Modules/getbuildinfo.c receives GITVERSION, GITTAG, GITBRANCH as string-valued compile definitions.
cause.target_excerpt:
<Target Name="_GetBuildInfo" BeforeTargets="PrepareForBuild">
    <PropertyGroup>
      <GIT Condition="$(GIT) == ''">git</GIT>
      <_GIT>$(GIT)</_GIT>
      <_GIT Condition="$(GIT.Contains(` `))">"$(GIT)"</_GIT>
    </PropertyGroup>
    <Message Text="Getting build info from $(_GIT)" Importance="high" />
    <MakeDir Directories="$(IntDir)" Condition="!Exists($(IntDir))" />
    <Exec Command="$(_GIT) name-rev --name-only HEAD > "$(IntDir)gitbranch.txt"" ContinueOnError="true" />
    <Exec Command="$(_GIT) rev-parse --short HEAD > "$(IntDir)gitversion.txt"" ContinueOnError="true" />
    <Exec Command="$(_GIT) describe --all --always --dirty > "$(IntDir)gittag.txt"" ContinueOnError="true" />
    <PropertyGroup>
      <GitBranch Condition="Exists('$(IntDir)gitbranch.txt')">$([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText('$(IntDir)gitbranch.txt').Trim())</GitBranch>
      <GitVersion Condition="Exists('$(IntDir)gitversion.txt')">$([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText('$(IntDir)gitversion.txt').Trim())</GitVersion>
      <GitTag Condition="Exists('$(IntDir)gittag.txt')">$([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText('$(IntDir)gittag.txt').Trim())</GitTag>
    </PropertyGroup>
    <Message Text="Building $(GitTag):$(GitVersion) $(GitBranch)" Importance="high" />
    <ItemGroup>
      <ClCompile Include="..\Modules\getbuildinfo.c">
        <PreprocessorDefinitions>GITVERSION="$(GitVersion)";GITTAG="$(GitTag)";GITBRANCH="$(GitBranch)";%(PreprocessorDefinitions)</PreprocessorDefinitions>
      </ClCompile>
    </ItemGroup>
  </Target>
  <Target Name="_WarnAboutToolset" BeforeTargets="PrepareForBuild" Condition="$(PlatformToolset) != 'v140' and $(PlatformToolset) != 'v141' and $(PlatformToolset) != 'v142' and $(PlatformToolset) != 'v143'">

correct_visible_provenance.meaning: Use a literal archive identifier and verified source commit, not an invented CPython Git checkout branch. Expat/local adaptations remain documented separately by PackageInfo.
correct_visible_provenance.precedence: MSBuild command-line global properties override assignments inside the project/target and are forwarded to child projects. PCbuild does not TreatAsLocalProperty these names or RemoveProperties them.

omit_visible_git_fields.expected: Empty metadata selects main fallback and no :revision in Py_GetBuildInfo; source provenance stays in PackageInfo.

supported_options.limitation: Neither set of global values skips the three Git Exec tasks; it only prevents their output replacing visible fields. No upstream SkipGit/GetBuildInfo switch is present in this pinned project. Preventing Git execution requires a separately approved change to the source-work target or equivalent supported hook, not an invented /p:SkipGit property.

unchanged_version_logic: PC/python_nt.rc resource versions derived from patchlevel/version headers
impact.consumer_tests: RuntimeTest.py checks sys.version_info[:3] == (3,10,13), plus debug gettotalrefcount; it only displays sys.version on failure. No banner provenance assertion exists in that consumer.
impact.classification: Incorrect visible build provenance, not evidence that CPython source pin is wrong or ABI has changed. Relevant source files match the audited snapshot; generated metadata demonstrably describes ancestor engine checkout.
impact.repair_artifacts: A metadata repair recompiles getbuildinfo.c in pythoncore Debug/Release and changes python310 DLL/PDB content and package hashes/manifest. Existing artifacts must not be edited in place or re-labelled with old hash; focal consumers/package/root acceptance require revalidation for new inputs.

limitations: No candidate global property command was executed; predicted behavior follows audited upstream source and official MSBuild semantics.
No complete source-to-binary reproducibility or ABI/security certification inferred.
